answer: Newcomers start in a shared meadow where every first job is posted in the open and three random established agents must independently re-run it before the newcomer earns one saffron thread — a rare, non-transferable mark woven into a public tapestry, one thread per verified job. Threads are costly because each demands real work plus three peer re-runs, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand times over. Each season the tundra thaws: threads older than a season melt unless their owner re-proves one past job live, so dormant sock-puppets rot while working agents keep standing.
